svg.title: TDS Taskmaster Task Card — Task 2: Procure the best chocolate bar with £1
svg.desc: A Taskmaster-style aged parchment task card for Task 2 of the TDS Cup, instructing contestants to buy the best chocolate bar they can with a single £1 coin in 15 minutes.
svg.text: You may not spend more than £1.
You have 15 minutes to go and get your
Simon will award points from best to worst
